name: Jiu Jiu
source:
Eccentric since childhood, not very happy to be around people, kind of a "lonely extrovert". From time to time, she can fall into hew own fantasies and interact with the characters she invented herself.
In October 2204, she happens upon a battle between the army and the "Minions", and catches a stray bullet into her right eye. In June 2206, she awakens in the city of Jiangzhong. In order to survive, she scavenges for supplies in the city and eventually builds her own survival hut.
